title: Understanding k-Means Clustering
text: In k-Means clustering, each point is assigned to the cluster whose center is closest to it. The center of a cluster is the average of all the points assigned to it. Can you calculate the distance from each team to the initial cluster centers?

title: Calculating Distances
text: To find the distance between two points, use the formula: distance $$=$$ $$\sqrt{\left(x2-x1\right)^2+\left(y2-y1\right)^2}$$. Try calculating the distance from Team O-Ski to both initial cluster centers.

title: Assigning Teams to Clusters
text: Once you have the distances, assign each team to the cluster with the nearest center. Which teams are closer to cluster A's initial center, and which are closer to cluster B's?

title: Updating Cluster Centers
text: After assigning teams to clusters, calculate the new center for each cluster. The new center is the average of the coordinates of all teams in that cluster. Can you find the new center for cluster B?
